title: Europa League top scorers 2016/17 to 2025/26
brief: Name the top scorer (or a joint top scorer) in the UEFA Cup or Europa League each season from 2016/17 to 2025/26.
period: UEFA Cup and Europa League seasons 2016/17 to 2025/26, main competition only

rows.name: Aritz Aduriz
rows.val: 8 goals, shared: Aritz Aduriz (Athletic Bilbao), Ciro Immobile (Lazio)

rows.name: Gerard Moreno
rows.val: 7 goals, shared: Gerard Moreno (Villarreal), Pizzi (Benfica), Borja Mayoral (Roma), Yusuf Yazici (Lille)

rows.name: Marcus Rashford
rows.val: 6 goals, shared: Marcus Rashford (Man Utd), Victor Boniface (Union SG)

rows.name: Bruno Fernandes
rows.val: 7 goals, shared: Bruno Fernandes (Man Utd), Kasper Hogh (Bodo/Glimt), Ayoub El Kaabi (Olympiacos)

rows.name: Igor Jesus
rows.val: 7 goals, shared: Igor Jesus (Nottingham Forest), Petar Stanic (Ludogorets)

notes.Klaas-Jan Huntelaar: Klaas-Jan Huntelaar never topped a season's list in this window.
notes.Luka Jovic: Luka Jovic scored 10 in 2018/19, one behind Giroud.

checks: Each season's top scorer from UEFA.com's season goal rankings (main competition only: first round onwards to 2008/09, group or league stage onwards from 2009/10, qualifying and play-offs left out), checked against Transfermarkt's season scorer lists; they agree on every season. Ties are shared rows (alts). Most slots for one player: Bruno Fernandes 2, so the 4-slot rule passes.
